**Paperhue 0.3.1** brings cards, photo backgrounds for calendar pages, two
new calendar pages, and Paperhue on phones: iPhone (through the Bluefy
browser) and Android.

## What's new

### Cards (牌卡)

Make a card from a background (your photo, cropped, or one of the panel's
seven colours) and a few text boxes: a status like "開會中，15:00 回來", a
meme with a short dialogue, or a quote. Save as many as you like in
**My cards** and send one to the device with a single tap. A card that is
already on one of the device's pages is shown by just switching the page, so
nothing has to be sent again. Cards can be exported and imported as
`.paperhue-card` files between all Paperhue apps.

### Calendar pages on your own photo

Any calendar page can use one of your photos as its background. The
calendar stays where it is and is drawn in white with a black outline on top
of the photo.

### New pages: Day and Month

- **Day (日):** today's date, large, with today's events.
- **Month (月曆):** the whole month on one page.

The existing pages are now called **Today + month** (本日＋月曆) and **Today +
week** (本日行程＋一週行程). With no calendar set up, the calendar pages show
the public Taiwan holidays calendar.

### Paperhue on phones

- **iPhone:** open https://markhhm.github.io/ulani-epaper/ in the Bluefy
  browser. Install the **Paperhue-Sync** Shortcut to send your iPhone's own
  calendars and reminders to the device; add a Time of Day automation in the
  Shortcuts app if you want it to run on its own. The phone must be
  unlocked and near the device. See the README's iPhone section.
- **Android:** download **Paperhue-Android.apk** below. It reads your phone's
  calendars (and optional iCal addresses), and can update the device in the
  background at times you choose.

### Scheduled updates

Scheduled updates are off until you pick the times, on every platform, and
redraw only calendar pages: cards, photos and notes are never replaced by a
scheduled update.

## Download

- **Windows:** Paperhue.exe
- **Mac:** Paperhue-macOS.zip (macOS 14 or newer; photos, crop and grain —
  calendar pages and cards come to the Mac in a later version)
- **Android:** Paperhue-Android.apk (allow installing apps from your browser
  when asked)
- **iPhone:** no download; use the Bluefy browser and the Shortcut (see above)

## Upgrading from 0.3.0

Replace Paperhue.exe with the new one; your pages, calendar sources and
schedule are kept.
